title: Unit 336
style: Jazz-funk chase groove with brisk swung drums and clipped upright bass; verse rides tense horn riffs and brushed snare, pre-chorus strips to bass, ride cymbal, and breathy calls, chorus hits with stabbing trumpet lines and gang shouts. Close-mic male vocals with tight doubles, talk-sung phrasing, and quick ad-lib echoes. Siren-like risers, reverse trumpet swells, and vinyl crackle flashes between sections. Bright, punchy, smoke-filled mix., low, jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Unit three-three-six
They call it the sneak pathera
Corners lean close
When the black sedan glides by
Low flo, slow step
Hands on the wheel, eyes narrow
Cash in the backseat
And the night got a pulse

[Pre-Chorus]
Keep it quiet
Keep it moving
One wrong turn and we’re done
Hold your breath now
Hear that trumpet
Like a warning from the sun

[Chorus]
Unit three-three-six (hey)
Pounce, low flo
Unit three-three-six (go)
Don’t let go
Trumpet screams
And the headlights chase
Unit three-three-six (hey)
Make that break

[Verse 2]
Sneaky pathera
Paws on the asphalt
Tail in the shadow
Not a sound, not a slip
Narrow alley
Old brick, wet puddles
Blue van behind us
Getting hot on the strip
